name_zh: 美国·马丁·路德·金：民权梦想与非暴力诺贝尔牧师
name_en: USA Martin Luther King: Civil Rights Dream & Non-Violence Nobel Pastor
description_zh: 马丁·路德·金 (1929-1968) 美国民权运动领袖，浸信会牧师，1955蒙哥马利巴士抵制，1963我有一个梦想演讲，1964诺贝尔和平奖，1968孟菲斯遇刺，非暴力抵抗改写美国种族法律。
description_en: Martin Luther King Jr. (1929-1968) US civil rights leader, Baptist minister, 1955 Montgomery Bus Boycott, 1963 I Have a Dream speech, 1964 Nobel Peace Prize, 1968 Memphis assassination, non-violent resistance rewrote US racial laws.
reason_zh: 金代表非暴力抵抗如何在法治框架内迫使种族隔离制度崩溃，展示了牧师身份如何为政治运动提供神学正当性与跨种族道德权威，其梦想演讲成为全球争取平等的永恒共同语言。
reason_en: King represents how non-violent resistance collapses segregation system within rule of law framework, demonstrating how minister identity provides theological legitimacy and cross-racial moral authority for political movement, his Dream speech becoming eternal common language for global equality struggles.
steps_zh: 研究金早年莫尔豪斯学院与波士顿大学神学博士
分析1955蒙哥马利巴士抵制与南方基督教领袖会议
探讨1963华盛顿大游行我有一个梦想演讲
评估1964民权法案1965投票权法案与反战立场
总结民权梦想非暴力蒙哥马利诺贝尔牧师对全球平等运动的永恒指引
steps_en: Study King early Morehouse College and Boston University theology PhD
Analyze 1955 Montgomery Bus Boycott and SCLC
Explore 1963 March on Washington I Have a Dream speech
Evaluate 1964 Civil Rights Act 1965 Voting Rights Act and anti-war stance
Summarize civil rights dream non-violence Montgomery Nobel Pastor eternal guidance for global equality movements
expected_zh: 掌握非暴力如何作为弱势群体在民主体制中争取权利的核心策略，理解神学正当性如何转化为跨种族政治联盟的凝聚力，评估金遗产对南非反种族隔离巴勒斯坦等全球正义运动的跨国激励。
expected_en: Master how non-violence serves as core strategy for marginalized groups claiming rights in democracy, grasp how theological legitimacy transforms into cross-racial political coalition cohesion, evaluate King legacy cross-national inspiration for South Africa anti-apartheid Palestine global justice movements.
case_zh: 1955 蒙哥马利；1963 梦想；1964 诺贝尔；1968 遇刺。民权梦想非暴力诺贝尔范式永存。
case_en: 1955 Montgomery; 1963 Dream; 1964 Nobel; 1968 assassination. Civil rights dream non-violence Nobel paradigm endures.
intellectual_tradition: American Civil Rights / Non-Violent Resistance / Christian Social Gospel
cross_cultural_impact: Civil rights; non-violence; Dream speech; Nobel; global equality movements
